hero.title: What Is Included on Riverside Luxury Cruises?
hero.subtitle: Everything You Need to Know About Dining, Suites, Excursions & Service
hero.description: One of the most common questions travelers ask before booking is: 'What is actually included on a Riverside Luxury Cruises vacation?' Riverside Luxury Cruises is designed to deliver a premium, boutique river cruise experience where many of the essentials are already part of your fare. From elegant accommodations and exceptional dining to personalized service and immersive European itineraries, Riverside focuses on creating a seamless luxury vacation. While inclusions can vary slightly by itinerary, you'll find that most cruises provide excellent value through a wide range of amenities and services. This guide walks through exactly what's included on a typical Riverside sailing—from suites and dining to beverages, Wi-Fi, excursions, and service—along with what's usually considered an optional extra.

quickAnswer.title: Quick Answer
bestFor: Wine, beer, and soft drinks with lunch and dinner
notBestFor: Premium alcoholic beverages and top-shelf spirits
Specialty wines from vintage cellar collections
quickAnswer.bottomNote: Some optional experiences, premium beverages, spa treatments, and specialty excursions may have an additional cost.

accommodations.title: Luxury Suite Accommodations
accommodations.subtitle: Every Riverside voyage begins with beautifully appointed accommodations designed for comfort and relaxation. Many Riverside suites are among the largest available on Europe's rivers.
paragraphs: Every Riverside voyage begins with beautifully appointed accommodations designed for comfort and relaxation. Many Riverside suites are among the largest available on Europe's rivers.
If having extra space is important to you, Riverside's suites deliver exceptional value on the river, offering plush king beds, marble bathrooms, separate sitting areas, and panoramic river views.
highlights: Sitting areas and beautiful river views
Climate control, TV, safe, and hair dryer

cards.title: Complimentary Wi-Fi
items: Guests receive complimentary onboard Wi-Fi throughout their cruise
Internet quality may vary depending on the ship's location along the river

cards.title: Wellness & Fitness
items: Riverside ships offer inviting wellness spaces where guests can stay active or relax
Walking track or open deck (where available)
Spa treatments and massage services may be available on select ships for an additional fee

beveragesIncluded.title: Beverages Included
beveragesIncluded.subtitle: Most Riverside cruises include wine and beer with lunch and dinner, soft drinks, specialty coffees, teas, and bottled water throughout the day.

items.title: Included Daily Beverages
items.description: Beverages are generously included with meals and throughout your sailing. Premium spirits, specialty cocktails, and select vintage wines may be available for an additional charge depending on the sailing package.

shoreExcursions.title: Shore Excursions
shoreExcursions.subtitle: Most itineraries include at least one guided excursion in many ports, giving guests an easy way to explore each destination without added planning. Some premium or small-group experiences may require an additional fee.

cards.title: 01. Historic Walking Tours
cards.description: Explore old towns and city centers with a knowledgeable local guide.

cards.title: 02. Castle & Cathedral Visits
cards.description: Step inside some of Europe's most iconic landmarks and architecture.

cards.title: 03. Wine Tastings
cards.description: Sample regional wines paired with insight into local winemaking traditions.

cards.title: 04. Museum & Local Market Visits
cards.description: Discover regional art, history, and culture in every port.

cards.title: 05. Scenic Coach Tours
cards.description: Take in the countryside and picturesque villages beyond the riverbank.

destinationsExplored.title: Destinations You'll Explore
destinationsExplored.subtitle: Depending on your itinerary, Riverside sails through some of Europe's most beautiful regions, including iconic rivers and storied cultural destinations.

items.title: Danube River
items.description: Explore Europe's majestic waterway connecting historic capital cities, baroque abbeys, and charming riverside villages including Budapest, Vienna, Bratislava, and Passau.

items.title: Rhine River
items.description: Sail through castle-dotted riverbanks, medieval towns, and vibrant European cultural centers from Amsterdam through Cologne, Strasbourg, and Basel.

items.title: Rhône River
items.description: Cruise the heart of southern France, from the gastronomy capital of Lyon to the Roman monuments and Provençal charm of Avignon.

items.title: Main & Moselle Rivers
items.description: Discover wine villages, rolling vineyards, timbered towns, and peaceful river scenery along Europe's most picturesque tributary waterways.

personalizedService.title: Personalized Service
personalizedService.subtitle: One of Riverside's greatest strengths is its exceptional hospitality. The crew's attention to detail creates an intimate boutique hotel atmosphere throughout your voyage.

items.title: Boutique Hospitality & Attention to Detail
items.description: The intimate size of the ships creates a welcoming environment where guests feel genuinely cared for. Staff members quickly learn guest preferences and provide attentive service.

cards.title: Onboard Amenities
items: Observation lounge with panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows
Spacious sun deck with 360-degree river views
Fitness center equipped with modern wellness machines
Outdoor seating and scenic viewing areas

cards.title: Evening Entertainment
items: Live piano music in the main lounge
Guided wine tastings with the onboard sommelier

gourmetDining.title: Gourmet Dining Throughout Your Cruise
gourmetDining.subtitle: Dining is one of Riverside's signature experiences. Menus change regularly to reflect the destinations visited during your cruise.

items.title: Breakfast & Lunch
items.description: Fresh pastries, seasonal fruits, eggs made to order, yogurts, European cheeses, regional specialties, fresh salads, soups, seafood, and artisan desserts.
features: Eggs cooked to order & fresh fruit
Fresh seafood and prime meat selections

items.title: Multi-Course Gourmet Dinners
items.description: Every evening features multi-course gourmet menus, regional European cuisine, chef specialties, premium ingredients, and fresh desserts celebrating local culinary traditions.
features: Regional European cuisine inspired by daily ports
Chef signatures crafted with local seasonal ingredients
Sommelier wine pairings with every course

whatsNotIncluded.title: What's Usually Not Included?
bestFor: Wine, beer, and soft drinks with meals
notBestFor: International airfare (unless part of a package)
Pre- and post-cruise hotels (unless included in a package)
whatsNotIncluded.bottomNote: Although Riverside includes many amenities, some items are generally additional. Always review your specific itinerary and booking confirmation for exact inclusions.

isAllInclusive.title: Is Riverside All-Inclusive?
notBestFor: Premium beverages outside meal hours may cost extra
Specialty spa treatments are not complimentary
Select private excursions carry an added fee
isAllInclusive.bottomNote: Riverside is often described as a luxury river cruise with extensive inclusions rather than a fully all-inclusive product. Most travelers find that the cruise fare already covers the majority of their vacation expenses, with only a few optional extras depending on personal preferences. The more you value comfort, service, and personalized hospitality, the greater the overall value Riverside provides.

faqs.question: Are meals included on Riverside Luxury Cruises?
faqs.answer: Yes. Breakfast, lunch, and dinner are typically included throughout your cruise.

faqs.question: Are drinks included?
faqs.answer: Wine, beer, soft drinks, coffee, tea, and water are generally included with meals. Premium beverages may cost extra.

faqs.question: Does Riverside include shore excursions?
faqs.answer: Most itineraries include selected guided excursions, while additional premium experiences may be available for purchase.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Complimentary Wi-Fi is generally available throughout the cruise.

faqs.question: Are gratuities included?
faqs.answer: Gratuity policies may vary by itinerary and booking package. Review your booking confirmation or consult your travel advisor for details.

faqs.question: Is airfare included?
faqs.answer: International airfare is usually not included unless purchased as part of a cruise package.

faqs.question: Does Riverside include airport transfers?
faqs.answer: Transfers may be included with certain packages or promotions. Confirm the details for your specific itinerary.

faqs.question: Are fitness facilities included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Guests have access to onboard fitness facilities throughout the cruise.

faqs.question: Is Riverside suitable for first-time river cruisers?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Its personalized service and relaxed atmosphere make it an excellent introduction to luxury river cruising.

faqs.question: Should I use a travel advisor when booking Riverside?
faqs.answer: Yes. A luxury travel advisor can explain inclusions, compare itineraries, recommend the best suite, and help coordinate every aspect of your trip.

faqs.question: Is room service included in the cruise fare?
faqs.answer: Yes, 24-hour room service is included for all guests, allowing you to dine in the comfort of your suite.

faqs.question: Are spa treatments and wellness services included?
faqs.answer: No, while the fitness facilities and relaxation spaces are complimentary, spa treatments and massage services incur an additional fee.

finalVerdict.title: What Is Included on Riverside Luxury Cruises?
paragraphs: Riverside Luxury Cruises includes many of the amenities travelers expect from a premium European river cruise—spacious accommodations, gourmet dining, beverages with meals, Wi-Fi, personalized service, and guided sightseeing.
Rather than overwhelming guests with endless options, Riverside focuses on delivering exceptional quality in every aspect of the journey.
The result is a refined, boutique luxury experience where comfort, hospitality, and destination immersion take center stage.
At Trips & Ships Luxury Travel, we'll help you understand what's included, compare itineraries, choose the perfect suite, and plan a seamless Riverside Luxury Cruises vacation.
